description: A configurable 2D game character sprite: original large orange alien character with a bulky rounded muscular body. Bright orange skin. Bald head. Most distinctive feature: one single large round eye centered in the face (cyclops). Wide friendly mouth. No normal nose. Big thick arms, large hands. Wears simple dark gray shorts or minimal outfit. Stands slightly wider than a human, thick legs, shorter proportions than the hero characters but much wider and bulkier.

animations.name: idle-lineup
animations.action: standing in a lineup for a family photo with the hero group, weight shifting slightly, single eye blinking slowly once during the loop, wide friendly smile, big arms at sides looking oddly cheerful about the whole thing
